transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is... I keep making myself throw up after I eat. It's gotten pretty bad. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at the laundry where I work, or right when I get home. I really hate it, but... I don't know, it's just started feeling like it's the only way I can actually calm down.
Before you make yourself throw up, do you usually eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

Yeah, I do. When it happens, it's like... I can go through a full bag of chips, some pastries from the corner store, whatever leftovers are around, and a bunch of sweet drinks all in one sitting. I honestly don't even really notice how much is gone until it's all empty.
Are you currently at a significantly low body weight for your height?
No, not really. I'm... I mean, my weight is pretty average for my height. I'm definitely not underweight or skinny, if that's what you mean.
When those eating episodes happen, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, I really do. Once I start, it's like... my hands just keep reaching for more food, even while I'm sitting there telling myself to stop. It's a weird feeling, almost like I'm just watching myself do it and I absolutely cannot make myself quit.
During those eating episodes, do you feel like you can’t stop or control how much you’re eating?
I think I just answered that, but yeah. I really can't stop once I start. It's like I have no control over it at all.
How much does your body shape or weight affect how you feel about yourself?

It affects everything, honestly. I mean... I can be doing really good at the shop, getting all my work done, but if I just happen to catch my reflection in the glass and my stomach or my hips look big to me... I instantly feel like a complete failure. It doesn't matter what else I accomplished that day, my weight and shape just completely dictate how I see myself.
